messages.subject: For Torbjorn Andersen | Public Affairs, Government Relations & Responsible Growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Andersen,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work sits directly across public affairs, government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and executive issue management in a major resource and energy-transition environment.

Aker Solutions is attractive to me because complex energy projects depend on more than engineering strength. Government relationships, regulatory readiness, local expectations, sustainability commitments and disciplined cross-functional execution often determine whether projects move smoothly, especially across international and growth markets.

I prepared a short Aker Solutions-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal showing where I would add value across public affairs, country readiness, stakeholder governance, responsible project execution and strategic partnerships. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I bring senior engagement experience across mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, standards, taxation, trade and investment institutions, together with renewable-energy stakeholder exposure around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I am open to Norway relocation, regional or global assignments, and employer-supported work authorization.

I would value a short confidential conversation about current or emerging Public Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing leadership needs within Aker Solutions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Public Affairs, Government Relations and Responsible Project Growth
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Aker Solutions competes through engineering, project execution and energy-transition capability across markets where governments, regulators, customers and communities shape the conditions for delivery. My value proposition sits around those external conditions. I lead director-level government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and stakeholder coordination for a major multinational mining operation. I would strengthen country readiness, public-affairs strategy and responsible project governance by giving leadership earlier visibility of institutional risks, clearer stakeholder objectives and disciplined cross-functional follow-through across projects and markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: Aker Solutions operates across a global energy industry undergoing structural change in regulation, technology, decarbonisation and industrial policy. Large projects carry country-specific dependencies involving permitting, public institutions, local-content expectations, human rights, sustainability, reputation and strategic partnerships. The company also enters a new leadership phase in 2026 with continued emphasis on performance, transformation and profitable growth. Public affairs therefore has a direct role in protecting execution, supporting market access and strengthening the institutional conditions around growth. The highest value comes when external intelligence reaches project and executive decisions early enough to change outcomes.

opportunities.title: Country and regulatory readiness before project pressure rises
opportunities.rationale: International projects often encounter avoidable delays when government, regulator, permitting, local-content or stakeholder dependencies are identified too late. Early country intelligence gives commercial and project teams more options and reduces expensive reactive management.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would create country-readiness briefs that map institutional dependencies, stakeholders, regulatory issues, reputation exposure and accountable internal owners before those factors become delivery constraints.

opportunities.title: Public affairs integrated with project governance
opportunities.rationale: Public affairs creates more business value when linked to project milestones, commercial decisions and executive risk reviews rather than operating as a parallel communications activity. Complex external issues often span legal, HSSE, sustainability and operations simultaneously.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build a cross-functional issue architecture connecting Public Affairs, Legal, Compliance, HSSE, Sustainability and project teams, with clear decision gates, evidence standards and escalation routes.

opportunities.title: Responsible growth and stakeholder trust
opportunities.rationale: Energy-transition and infrastructure projects face rising expectations around community impact, human rights, responsible supply chains and local benefits. Credible governance helps protect reputation while improving the quality and durability of stakeholder relationships.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would bring operating experience in ESG, social performance, grievances, institutional partnerships and evidence-based commitments to strengthen stakeholder planning and responsible-project follow-through.

opportunities.title: Strategic partnerships across growth markets
opportunities.rationale: Growth markets often require strong relationships with ministries, regulators, state entities, customers, industry bodies and investment institutions. The quality of these relationships affects opportunity development, risk visibility and execution confidence.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would structure relationship strategies around specific business objectives, decision timelines and ownership, supported by experience maintaining senior public-sector interfaces across multiple regulatory and commercial domains.

days_0_30: Map priority markets, projects, public-affairs dependencies and material external stakeholders for the selected scope.
Review existing government, regulatory, sustainability and reputation workstreams for ownership gaps or late-stage risk.
Identify the highest-value issues where earlier executive visibility would improve project or commercial decisions.
days_31_60: Introduce a concise country and stakeholder readiness brief for selected projects or markets.
Build engagement plans tied to project milestones, regulatory decisions and strategic partnerships.
Create a cross-functional issue register linking external risks to owners, evidence and escalation thresholds.
days_61_90: Advance two priority country-facing issues to measurable next steps.
Deliver an executive dashboard covering institutional dependencies, stakeholder position and execution status.
Agree a 12-month public-affairs plan linked to market access, project readiness and reputation outcomes.
days_91_180: Embed the model across selected projects or regions and refine it from live execution lessons.
Strengthen senior institutional relationships in markets where policy and public-sector decisions materially affect growth.
Measure response time, stakeholder access, issue closure and evidence quality against agreed leadership outcomes.

potential_impact: Earlier identification and management of government, regulatory and stakeholder risks around projects.
Stronger alignment between public affairs, sustainability and project execution.
Improved institutional relationships tied to specific commercial and delivery objectives.
Clearer executive visibility of external dependencies, ownership and follow-through.
background_relevance: Director-level leadership across government relations, regulatory affairs, ESG, social responsibility, stakeholder strategy and executive communications.
Senior engagement with ministries, regulators and public institutions across mining, environment, energy, labour, aviation, standards, taxation, trade and investment.
Cross-functional coordination across Environment, HSE, Legal, Finance, Operations, Procurement, HR, Security, Aviation and technical teams.
Renewable-energy stakeholder exposure around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
